text:
bad freezer odor will not come out of these molds, even soaking in bleach won't fix it. Second update. After soaking it in bleach and running it through the dishwasher again, the smell is almost gone. I will use it again. The rating was changed again from 1 to 3 stars.

Update, I had to change the rating from 5 to 1 stars.

After the first batch, the molds gained a freezer odor. I wasted time and money making a second batch of keto fat bombs. The freezer odor on this set after only 2 times in the freezer is ruined. I have washed these in the dishwasher and also soaked them in bleach. The odor won't come out!

After starting the Keto diet I wanted to try several recipes including fat bombs. I did not have a mold. These looked great. They reminded me of peanut butter cups ( my favorite ) I whipped up a batch of cheesecake fat bombs after running these thru the dishwasher. I filled them up and threw them in the freezer. The next day I got it out and popped the fat bombs right out.

These are great and I may have to order more in different sizes. As I said, this is my first time using silicone molds and I love them. They stay flexible when frozen and wash great in the dishwasher.
